disclosure: none — no public or partial disclosure permitted
in_scope_note: Each named .fc is a thin entry that #includes its subtree (contracts/router/**, contracts/pool/** incl. 5 pool types, contracts/lp_account/**, contracts/lp_wallet/**, contracts/common/**). The compiled contract = entry + includes, so the included handlers are in scope.

critical: direct theft of any user funds
high: freeze ability of other users to trade
medium: griefing (no profit motive for attacker, but damage to users/protocol)

out_of_scope_classes: disguising one asset as another asset
lp jetton wallet issues (jetton-wallet standard itself)
contract deletion caused by inability to pay rent
loss of funds caused by price slippage: frontrunning, backrunning, sandwich attacks
out_of_scope_note: lp_wallet.fc is in the asset table (Critical) BUT 'issues related to lp jetton wallets' are OOS — in-scope ONLY where lp_wallet mis-interacts with lp_account/pool (e.g. wrong burn/mint accounting feeding the pool), NOT the TEP-74/89 jetton-wallet standard behavior itself.
prohibited_activities: any testing with pricing oracles or third-party smart contracts
any denial-of-service attacks against live systems
testing_policy: Local @ton/sandbox (in-process TVM) only — no broadcasts, no keys. Read-only get-method recon of the testnet router (kQAFpeGFJQA9KqiCxXZ8J4l__vSYAxFSirSOvPHn6SSX4ztn) is permitted (no transactions).
